title: TELOS authorization chain — every authz run, its record, and its outcome
note: One entry per SPINE authorization run on disk (authz-001..008); module enrollment runs live in enrollment_runs below. Refusals are PRESERVED, never erased — five of eight spine runs refused authorization, which is the fail-closed posture demonstrated, not a failure history to clean up. Entries with a plan_path are re-hashed from disk by the verifier; authz-001..003 reviewed candidate bytes that are not preserved as matured-plan files on main, so their plan_ref is record-internal only (checked against the record, not the disk) — recorded honestly rather than reconstructed. Quest-class runs (activation-deferred successor authorizations under the Iliad, e.g. product-1) live in quest_runs below; they do NOT change the active authority until their two-phase activation completes.

chain.block_cause: codex decision 'revise' (required-seat dissent); AM-41's blanket hashbang exclusion contradicted Task 5's weave.mjs shebang

why: A future model must be able to walk authorization history without inferring outcomes from filenames or assuming success. The chain shows the gate refusing five times — including refusing a Daedalus-converged plan on one required seat's dissent (authz-007) — and shows every run under trust_mode signed. That record IS the trust model, demonstrated.
change_rule: A new authorization appends an entry (council run -> record committed under docs/runs/ -> CURRENT-AUTHORITY.json updated -> this contract updated in the same change or verify-contracts fails). Entries are never rewritten.

oracle.source_of_truth: the authorization-summary.json records on disk + CURRENT-AUTHORITY.json
oracle.contract_equals_code: docs/institutional-memory/verify-contracts.mjs (each record exists, parses, and matches this entry; plan_path entries re-hashed from disk; exactly one active entry equal to CURRENT-AUTHORITY.active_authorization; superseded statuses cross-checked)

quest_runs.supersedes_deferred_grant: SUSPENDED prior grant over plan_ref sha256:bb2ea18f… (commit 97becd37)
quest_runs.note: Quest-class chain entry, ACTIVATION-DEFERRED to Phase B. CURRENT-AUTHORITY.active_plan/active_authorization are NOT changed by this entry; v15/authz-008 remains the active repository authority until Phase B completes. Not an enrollment_run (no module root). Machine-checked by the phase-aware §5d verifier slice when it lands; until then integrity evidence is the authorization-summary + step-ledger.
